completion:
Collect operational data.
3. Utilize continuous emission monitoring systems (CEMS).
4. Record all relevant parameters.
5. Document exceedances and compliance issues.
6. Include historical contextual data.
7. Describe equipment malfunctions and their impact.
8. Report on maintenance activities and their results.
9. Detail corrective actions taken.
10. Conduct air dispersion modeling.
11. Use precision measurement tools.
12. Include meteorological data.
13. Follow regulatory reporting requirements.
14. Quote the relevant emission standards and limits.
15. Summarize the findings.
16. Provide recommendations for improvement.
17. Include data from manual stack tests, if applicable.
18. Archive backup data and source documents.
19. Present the report following prescribed reporting formats.
20. Review for accuracy and completeness before submission.
